37K likes, 67 comments - basilzaman_k on September 26, 2026: "Brother @khalafbukhatir ❤️🫂

എല്ലാവരും ഒരുമിച്ച് അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ അടുത്ത് ചെല്ലുന്നതും നമ്മുടെ കളികളും ചിരികളും ഒക്കെ കണ്ട് അദ്ദേഹം ചിരിക്കുന്നതും കാണാൻ നമുക്ക് ഒരു സന്തോഷം ആണ് ❤️

khalafuuuu🥹❤️🫂

Thank you so much brother for everything you have done for us ❤️We truly appreciate the kindness and support you have shown us

It had been my long-time wish to meet you because I know how you have treated our brother Hanan from the very beginning until now💥I think when he first came to Dubai he came here looking for a job .At that time you encouraged him to continue pursuing his career in music ❤️You told him that if he didn’t succeed in the music field you would give him a job.You motivated him to stay focused on his passion and that support meant so much to him💯

We will always be grateful to you Once again thank you so much for supporting my brother Hanan all this time Because of him we had the opportunity to meet you and I am truly happy about that❤️

I love you so much Insha Allah we will meet again soon Kalafuuuu! ❤️".
